# Compute aggregated signatures from individual signatures with different percentile threshold

##### Load libraries and sort scripts

```{r}
library(readr)
library(here)
source(here("scripts/00_background_genes_PA_functions.R"))
source(here("scripts/01_signature_aggregation_functions.R"))
```

### Getting up/dn microarray/RNAseq signatures

```{r}
# set up parameters
technologies = c("microarray", "RNAseq")
directions = c("up","dn")
bg_source = "LINCS" # L1000 genes
lincs_genetype= "landmark"
threshold_pct <- c(0.95,0.90,0.85,0.80,0.75,0.70,0.65,0.6,0)

for(threshold in threshold_pct){
  for(technology in technologies){
    for(direction in directions){
      # set up paths
      metadata_path = here(paste0("data/signatures/",technology,"_TB_signature_run_info.tsv"))
      data_path = here(paste0("data/signatures/",technology))
      output_dir = here(paste0("data/signatures/",technology,"/aggregated_signatures_sensitivity"))
      extension = paste0("_",direction,".tsv")
      
      # get gene membership matrix and save it
      gene_membership_matrix = compute_membership_matrix(metadata_path = metadata_path, data_path = data_path, 
                            direction = direction, bg_source = bg_source, 
                            output_dir = output_dir, lincs_genetype = lincs_genetype, extension = extension, save_result=TRUE)
      
      # get jaccard matrix and save it
      jaccard_matrix = compute_jaccard_matrix(metadata_path = metadata_path, data_path = data_path, 
                         direction = direction, output_dir = output_dir, save_result=TRUE) 
      
      # compute aggregates signature and save it
      aggregate_signatures(gene_membership_matrix, jaccard_matrix, output_dir, direction, threshold_pct = threshold, save_result=TRUE)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r plot gene counts}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

technologies <- c(
  "microarray",
  "RNAseq"
)

directions <- c(
  "up",
  "dn"
)

threshold_pct <- c(0.95,0.90,0.85,0.80,0.75,0.70,0.65,0.60,0)

format_threshold <- function(x) {
  if_else(
    x == 0,
    "0",
    format(
      x,
      scientific = FALSE,
      trim = TRUE
    )
  )
}

read_aggregate_gene_count <- function(
    technology,
    direction,
    threshold
) {
  threshold_text <- format_threshold(
    threshold
  )

  aggregate_dir <- here(
    "data",
    "signatures",
    technology,
    "aggregated_signatures_sensitivity"
  )

  filename <- paste0(
    direction,
    "_aggregated_signature_",
    threshold_text,
    ".tsv"
  )

  file_path <- file.path(
    aggregate_dir,
    filename
  )

  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    stop(
      "Aggregated signature file not found: ",
      file_path
    )
  }

  signature_df <- read_tsv(
    file_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  gene_count <- if (
    "GeneID" %in% names(signature_df)
  ) {
    signature_df %>%
      filter(!is.na(GeneID)) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n_distinct(GeneID)
      ) %>%
      pull(n)
  } else {
    nrow(signature_df)
  }

  tibble(
    technology = technology,
    direction = direction,
    threshold_value = threshold,
    threshold_label = paste0(
      threshold * 100,
      "%"
    ),
    gene_count = gene_count,
    filename = filename,
    file_path = file_path
  )
}

gene_count_df <- crossing(
  technology = technologies,
  direction = directions,
  threshold_value = threshold_pct
) %>%
  pmap_dfr(
    function(
        technology,
        direction,
        threshold_value
    ) {
      read_aggregate_gene_count(
        technology = technology,
        direction = direction,
        threshold = threshold_value
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    technology = recode(
      technology,
      microarray = "Microarray",
      RNAseq = "RNA-seq"
    ),
    technology = factor(
      technology,
      levels = c(
        "Microarray",
        "RNA-seq"
      )
    ),
    direction = recode(
      direction,
      up = "Upregulated",
      dn = "Downregulated"
    ),
    direction = factor(
      direction,
      levels = c(
        "Upregulated",
        "Downregulated"
      )
    ),
    threshold_label = factor(
      threshold_label,
      levels = paste0(
        threshold_pct * 100,
        "%"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    direction,
    technology,
    match(
      threshold_value,
      threshold_pct
    )
  )

print(gene_count_df)
```

```{r save pdf}
pdf(here("figures/figure3/Figure3_gene_counts_all_thresholds_.pdf"),width = 11,height = 6)

gene_count_plot <- ggplot(
  gene_count_df,
  aes(
    x = threshold_label,
    y = gene_count,
    color = direction,
    group = direction
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = scales::comma(gene_count)
    ),
    vjust = -0.7,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(direction),
    cols = vars(technology),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Upregulated" = "#D55E00",
      "Downregulated" = "#0072B2"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma,
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.05, 0.15)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Aggregation percentile threshold",
    y = "Number of genes",
    color = "Gene group"
  ) +
  theme_bw(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black"
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey95",
      color = NA
    ),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(gene_count_plot)

dev.off()
```
